MadeJustForYou
© 2026 · Made just for you, one order at a time.

Full homepage lives in MadeJustForYou Homepage — the warm palette, stitched-heart mark, Playfair wordmark and Caveat signature working together end-to-end.

One system, three fixed jobs

DO
  • Keep the brand name “MadeJustForYou” in the Playfair serif everywhere — web and packaging.
  • Use the Caveat signature for short warm lines (“made just for you”) on both surfaces.
  • Pair the stitched-heart mark with the wordmark for the primary lockup.
DON'T
  • Set the brand name in the handwritten script — that’s the inconsistency to avoid.
  • Swap fonts by surface (“serif online, script on packaging”). Each font’s job is fixed, not the surface.
  • Recolour the mark outside the approved clay / honey / ink colourways.
